output.content: The current data ingestion process is entirely manual. {data_dave} has confirmed that no automated checks are in place for the incoming data streams. Every dataset is reviewed by hand before it is passed to the next stage. This manual process is time-consuming and prone to human error, as noted in the latest system audit. The logs show that data validation occurs only after the ingestion is complete, which can lead to delays in identifying issues.
output.reclassify_reason: The statement describes an objective situation without expressing any wishes, refusals, acceptances, trade-offs, or needs.
